fig.name: FIG Panel
fig.description: Full FIG-style panel: 6 execution, 1 difficulty, 1 time of flight, 1 horizontal displacement, 1 head judge (penalties).

local.name: Local Panel
local.description: Simplified panel for local competitions without electronic timing/displacement equipment: 4 execution, 1 difficulty, 1 head judge (penalties).

test.name: Test Panel
test.description: Test panel for development and testing purposes.

test_synchro.name: Test Synchro Panel
test_synchro.description: Synchro test panel for development and testing purposes: one judge per role, synchronisation as device mark.

fig_synchro.name: FIG Synchro Panel
fig_synchro.description: FIG synchronised panel: 3 execution judges per trampoline, 1 difficulty, 1 horizontal displacement and 1 synchronisation (device) operated by the same person, 1 head judge (penalties).

local_synchro.name: Local Synchro Panel
local_synchro.description: Simplified synchronised panel without a synchro device: 2 execution judges per trampoline, 1 difficulty, 1 synchronisation judge scoring per skill, 1 head judge (penalties).
